intent: P7 Sprint 1 batch (496b84d..8ea056b): 14 commits. StateMachineService 强制写审计三字段 (R-03 T0) + EquipmentList ORM + SourceService V1.4 字段 (T1) + EquipmentTypeCodes seed (T1.5) + EQUIP_LIST 同步服务 + SourceModule dispatcher (T2) + UTIL V1.3 基线 (util_results + 13 类 + 折标煤 13→6 映射, T3) + audit_logs JSONB GIN 索引 (D8) + review I1+I2 fix + EQUIP_LIST API + persist_service (S1-4b) + UTIL API + source_aggregator (S1-5b) + 6 deferred Minor polish + G-08 baseline roll.
peer_coverage: Adversarial lens ran via in-process adversarial-reviewer (no codex CLI; fallback per cross-model-review.md).

primary_findings.title: PSYCHRO type_code 'X' collides with 'Motor/Electrical' — psychrometric CHECKED mis-classified as electrical
primary_findings.suggested_fix: Either change PSYCHRO type_code to a unique letter (e.g., 'P' if free) OR add PSYCHRO-specific code to SEED_TYPE_CODES.

primary_findings.title: GET /util/summary 'latest' returns random UtilResult (UUIDv4 util_result_id order, not created_at)
primary_findings.suggested_fix: Order by `created_at DESC` instead of util_result_id DESC.

primary_findings.title: State machine audit bypass — sync_from_source mutates EquipmentList.sign_status directly (no AuditLog writes)
evidence: sync_service.py:128, 167 — sync_from_source mutates EquipmentList.sign_status via direct ORM update
sync_service.py writes zero AuditLog rows; bypasses state_machine.transition(); TRANSITION_ROLES ACL not consulted
primary_findings.suggested_fix: Route EquipmentList.sign_status updates through state_machine.transition(); add Postgres trigger as defense-in-depth (out of Sprint scope; document in ADR-0045).

primary_findings.title: Cross-project IDOR — every endpoint trusts client project_id/workspace_id; ACL only checks role
evidence: equip_list.py + util.py — 12 endpoints accept arbitrary project_id/workspace_id without ownership check
persist_service.py:103, util.py:62 — None-leak: omit project_id ⇒ unfiltered rows from all projects
primary_findings.suggested_fix: Add UserProject/WorkspaceMember model + per-project ACL check; pre-existing across PCS.

primary_findings.title: audit_logs GIN index built without CONCURRENTLY — blocks all audit writes during build (production outage)
evidence: audit_logs is hot append-only table; CREATE INDEX acquires SHARE lock that blocks DML for build window
primary_findings.suggested_fix: Add postgresql_concurrently=True and if_not_exists=True to op.create_index.

primary_findings.title: UtilResults ORM missing composite (project_id, workspace_id) index — schema drift vs migration
evidence: Migration creates 3 indexes; ORM __table_args__ only declares ix_util_results_project

primary_findings.title: advisory_lock silent no-op on OperationalError; acks rollout race protection
SourceModule dispatcher silently drops unknown modules — enables feature-probing
summary_service coalesces 'absent' vs 'explicit 0' silently
RESOLVE_STALE_CHANGED records hash_changed=false — semantic mismatch
aggregate_and_save overwrites manual entries for 6 unmapped categories
summary_service generic write loop drops 6 of 13 categories silently
query_by_fuel_year returns stale coefficient on year-rollover (2027 → 2026)
G-08 baseline + endpoint code in same batch — frontend snapshot drift risk
bulk-sync Pydantic Literal validation contradicts endpoint's 'partial failure 容错' claim
EquipmentTypeCodeService.seed_defaults all-or-nothing — partial pre-seeding blocks remaining codes
EquipmentTypeCode count 3-way mismatch: 26 docstring / 31 SEED / 24 KEY_TYPE_CODES
consumption_json dict[str, float] accepts NaN/Inf — poisons downstream toe_total
GET /equipment-list/{id} and /util/results/{id} return any record by UUID — no ownership filter
toe_total counts 6 categories (incl CONDENSATE) but by_category returns only 5

pre_existing_findings: Cross-project IDOR (F-P0-004) is pre-existing across PCS backend (not introduced by Sprint 1).
residual_risks: Cascade (per adversarial F-017): 4 silent-passes compound — mid-Sprint project shows '0 of everything' with no drift signal.
Audit trail coverage: state_machine.transition() called once in Sprint 1 (audit_observations); sync_service direct mutates skip audit (F-P0-003).
PostgreSQL production deploy of p7_s1_002 will cause minutes-long audit_logs INSERT block; cannot rollback mid-build.
EquipmentTypeCodes seed not atomic with schema migration (DM-P7S1-003).

No GIN index build-time measurement; post-deploy verification SQL documented but not in CI.
No test verifies CONDENSATE included in toe_total but excluded from by_category (AC-001).
No test for query_by_fuel_year year-rollover behavior (stale coefficient on 2027).
No test for advisory_lock OperationalError silent no-op (production misconfig).
No test for EquipmentTypeCodeService.seed_defaults idempotency with partial pre-seeding.
